title: Normal form of direct-image composition in the projective-line chart
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, N a natural number annihilating A, and t normalized finite twist transport [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. Let S be a scheme with N invertible in its global sections. Write P=ProjectiveLine(S), q:P→S, W=P×_S P, and choose either projection p:W→P by a Boolean a. Let e:ProjectiveLine(P)→W be its canonical chart [def-sp-p1-diagonal-charts] and r:ProjectiveLine(P)→P the projective projection, so r=e≫p. Put B=A_W(1)[2] and choose any proof hW that N is invertible on W. Then ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalChartMap [lem-sp-finite-p1-diagonal-kummer-component-formula] is Rp applied to the chart adjunction unit at B, followed by the component at Le(B) of rightDerivedLowerStarCompHom(e,p,r,r=e≫p), followed by Rr applied to the shifted normalized line comparison for e using hW. No exchange map occurs in this equation.

source.place: The composite-adjunction counit in the paragraphs identifying the two projections with base change of q; the direct-image composition step before the trace.

proof.text: Expand ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalChartMap and its recorded ordinaryFiniteChartTransport wrapper. Expand ordinaryFiniteAdjunction to the canonical derived adjunction. Its factors are Rp of the chart adjunction unit, the component of rightDerivedLowerStarComp(e,p), the component of rightDerivedLowerStarCongr(e≫p=r), and Rr of the chart shifted-line comparison.

Use r=e≫p from the canonical chart. Prove the direct-image comparison identity at the level of natural transformations: substitute r=e≫p, use rightDerivedLowerStarCongr_refl, and use conjugateEquiv_leftDerivedUpperStarComp_hom. Evaluate at Le(B) with NatTrans.congr_app. Use congrArg and associativity to compose on both sides with the mapped unit and mapped line comparison.

Specialize to the chart and shifted line. Identify the witnesses of invertibility by proof irrelevance. Compare the recorded category and functor applications by explicit heterogeneous congruence, unfolding only the recorded chart-transport and adjunction wrappers and small object aliases; this avoids expanding derived-category localization data. The resulting equality of propositions transports the preceding proof to the original goal. No positivity is used, including for N=0; both Boolean choices and empty schemes are covered.

theorem chartMap_compHom
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (a : Bool)
    (hW : IsUnit (N : Γ(pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S), ⊤))) :
    ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalChartMap A N hA t S hS a =
      let e := (projectiveLineDiagonalChart S a).val.hom
      let p := projectiveLineDiagonalProjection S a
      let r := ProjectiveLine (ProjectiveLine S) ↘ ProjectiveLine S
      let B := (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA
        (pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
      (ordinaryFinitePushforward A p).map
          ((derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).unit.app B) ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerStarCompHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e p r
          (projectiveLineDiagonalChart S a).property.symm).app
            ((ordinaryFinitePullback A e).obj B) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A r).map
          (ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA t e hW).hom
